description: This file implements stack backtrace and crash handling features using unwinding and symbol resolution functions, primarily intended for debugging purposes. It provides functions to initialize crash handlers, dump the current stack trace, and resolve addresses to function names and object files.

methods.name: void backtrace_init(void)
methods.description: Initializes crash signal handlers to generate stack dump on crash.

methods.name: backtrace_sig_crash
methods.description: Signal handler that triggers stack dump and re-raises signal if necessary.

methods.name: void backtrace_dump(void)
methods.description: Outputs the current stack trace to logs or file.

methods.name: bool backtrace(backtrace_func_t * func,void * ctx)
methods.description: Starts stack traversal, invoking a callback for each frame.

methods.name: backtrace_handle
methods.description: Internal handler invoked during unwinding to process each stack frame.

methods.name: backtrace_dump_cbk
methods.description: Callback used during stack traversal to process each address.

methods.name: backtrace_copy
methods.description: Copies current backtrace addresses into an array.

methods.name: backtrace_resolve
methods.description: Resolves a stack address to function name and filename.
